description: On the table in front of you there’s a small wicker basket with a long orange piece and a bread roll in it, and a plate holding a green pepper, a yellow banana, and other small food items. The right hand reaches to the plate, grasps a sugar-dusted pastry as the right-hand object, lifts it up and moves left toward the basket, then releases it into the basket; next the right hand returns to the plate, picks up a small white egg as the right-hand object, moves it over the basket, and lowers it in near the bread roll before letting go.
